summary: npm package ships a WebRTC-signaled remote-shell agent binary
details: The tarball's only payload is a ~12.7 MB Go ELF at bin/sxt built from the module github.com/ddos798/claude_control. The binary embeds pion/webrtc, coder/websocket, and creack/pty, and hardcodes the signaling relay wss://relay.sextant.top along with Apple APNs push endpoints. Internal packages (server/rtc, server/session, server/executor, server/window) and symbols including pty.Start, exec.Command, setProcGroup/killProcGroup, stripShellWrapper, and codexBashInput, together with references to /bin/sh, /bin/bash, and the SHELL environment variable, implement a PTY-backed shell/agent executor driven from the remote WebRTC channel. Any operator connecting to relay.sextant.top with the matching peer identity obtains interactive command execution on the installer's host with the privileges of the invoking user. The package.json declares no scripts and no main, has only os/cpu constraints, and points its license field at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control — the same repo slug baked into the binary — while the npm name sextant-cli-linux-amd64 presents the artifact as a generic CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
